rules.title: Variant
rules.rule_text: Front panel must display Oat Vanilla.

rules.title: Net quantity
rules.rule_text: Front panel must display 330 mL (11.2 FL OZ).

rules.title: Ingredients
rules.rule_text: Back panel must list ingredients: Organic Cold Brewed Arabica Coffee, Oat Milk, Natural Vanilla Extract, Sea Salt.
rules.literal_expected: Organic Cold Brewed Arabica Coffee, Oat Milk, Natural Vanilla Extract, Sea Salt.

rules.title: Storage directions
rules.rule_text: Left panel must state: Shake gently. Best served chilled.

rules.title: Manufacturer statement
rules.rule_text: Back panel must declare: Brewed & Canned by Zenith Beverage Co., Portland, OR 97201
rules.literal_expected: Brewed & Canned by Zenith Beverage Co., Portland, OR 97201
